title: more powerful decoder for L_0 left to future work
description: The decoder for the first reverse step is a simple independent discrete decoder; a more powerful decoder (e.g., a conditional autoregressive model) is identified as straightforward but left to future work.
canonical_description: simple independent decoder for first reverse step could be replaced with more powerful conditional decoder

evidence.quote: It would be straightforward to instead incorporate a more powerful decoder like a conditional autoregressive model, but we leave that to future work.
